2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000030_KRILE
2.description: Still locked in slumber. But otherwise in good physical health.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000060_TATARU
5.description: ...Oh no, is something wrong with them!?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000080_KRILE
7.description: I summoned you after detecting faint signs of instability in Thancred's corporeal aether. But subsequent examinations suggested all five might be affected. And when I examined them just now, my fears were confirmed.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000090_KRILE
8.description: Tellingly, the degree of instability varies between them.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000100_KRILE
9.description: Thancred exhibits the most notable signs, followed by Y'shtola and Urianger. The twins' aether, meanwhile, remains relatively stable, but there is a change there too if one knows to look for it.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000110_TATARU
10.description: Hold on─isn't that the order they were called away in?

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000120_KRILE
11.description: Indeed. Which leads me to believe the instability will only increase with time.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000130_KRILE
12.description: Though I can but speculate, I fear this may be a symptom of a weakening link between body and soul.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000140_TATARU
13.description: By the gods... What happens if the link is broken?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000150_KRILE
14.description: I cannot say for certain─this is all unknown territory to us. Yet whatever happens, it cannot be good.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000160_KRILE
15.description: Mercifully, the instability is still only slight. And you may rest assured Master Matoya and I will do everything in our power to keep it from worsening.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000170_KRILE
16.description: Be that as it may, it is imperative that you find a way to restore our friends' souls to their bodies.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
19.description: No rest for the righteous, eh?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000190_KRILE
21.description: I realize you've only just returned from saving two worlds, but time is not on our side.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000200_TATARU
22.description: But where's <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> even supposed to start? We had the greatest minds in the realm hunting high and low for an answer, and they ran out of places to look.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000210_KRILE
23.description: You stated in your report that the Exarch had originally intended to reverse the summoning process by means of his own death, correct?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000220_KRILE
24.description: Raha always was a reckless young fool... Ready to die for the first righteous cause that came along.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000230_KRILE
25.description: His plan might well have worked, but I for one am glad he never had the opportunity to see it through. Even if it does mean our friends must remain stranded awhile longer.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000240_KRILE
26.description: There is another way, I am sure of it. And the key lies with him. With the Exarch.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000250_KRILE
27.description: Pray return to the First and apprise him and the others of the situation.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000260_KRILE
28.description: We, meanwhile, will do what we can from here and, if the fates are kind, we will have good news to share upon your return.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000280_YSHTOLA
30.description: Will Thancred and Ryne not be joining us?

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000290_URIANGER
31.description: Nay, milady. With apologies to all, they beg leave to pursue their investigation of the Empty to its conclusion. Should matters here demand their presence, however, they did assure me that they would make themselves available.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000300_MYSTERYVOICE
32.description: Yes, of course. Then let us proceed.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000310_MYSTERYVOICE
33.description: I...I think it best that you begin by providing a summary of Mistress Krile's findings.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000320_ALPHINAUD
34.description: I suppose it was only to be expected that some change would occur...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000330_YSHTOLA
35.description: Yet our souls seem unaffected. To my eye, at least.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000340_YSHTOLA
36.description: How long they will remain so is another question. Krile is right. It is imperative we find a way to return to the Source.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000350_MYSTERYVOICE
37.description: Perhaps an explanation of the method by which I brought you here will yield some inspiration.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000360_MYSTERYVOICE
38.description: Ere I begin, it must be noted that I am by no means a gifted mage. In order to employ powerful magicks, I must rely upon the Crystal Tower and its boundless reservoirs of energy.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000370_MYSTERYVOICE
39.description: The magick that summoned you was no exception. 'Tis a singular spell, adapted through painstaking effort from the technique that transported me to the First.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000380_MYSTERYVOICE
40.description: To use an analogy, it works by cutting a hole in the fabric of reality. A hole tailored to the object of summoning, through which it─and it alone─may pass unscathed.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000390_MYSTERYVOICE
41.description: Though I succeeded in creating said hole, I failed to latch onto my intended target. Instead of you, the spell found those close to you, and ended up summoning them in their incomplete state...

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000400_MYSTERYVOICE
42.description: I would not soon throw my life away─not after the lengths you and yours went to save it.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000410_MYSTERYVOICE
43.description: And so long as I breathe, I will spare no effort to see you safely home.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000420_MYSTERYVOICE
44.description: But should all else fail, and your lives be at stake, there remains one sure method...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000450_ALISAIE
47.description: How can you even entertain such thoughts!? You owe your life to the Warrior of Light, and you don't get to die unless <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> says so.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000460_YSHTOLA
48.description: Your followers await your divine judgment.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000490_YSHTOLA
52.description: If the two of you have finished, perhaps we could return to our discussion?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000500_YSHTOLA
53.description: Rather than dwelling upon the multiple failed attempts at transference, I think it would behoove us to focus on the solitary success.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000510_YSHTOLA
54.description: I would draw your attention to the fact that our friend can travel between worlds possessed not only of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> body and soul, but <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> personal effects besides.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000520_YSHTOLA
55.description: This is no different from the teleportation magicks to which we are all accustomed─magicks that allow for the transportation of those inanimate objects one considers to be an extension of oneself.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000530_ALPHINAUD
56.description: Are you suggesting that, simply by considering us his possessions, he could carry our souls back to the Source upon his person?

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000540_ALPHINAUD
57.description: Are you suggesting that, simply by considering us her possessions, she could carry our souls back to the Source upon her person?

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000550_ALISAIE
58.description: Well, it would be nice if things were that simple for a change.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000560_ALISAIE
59.description: But vague notions of ownership seem a rather tenuous thing to stake our lives on. So much as a moment of doubt on <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> part, and we'd be left floating in the rift.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000570_URIANGER
60.description: Milady hath the right of it. The requisite fixity of belief would be too much to ask even of our friend.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000580_URIANGER
61.description: Yet were we to immure our souls within an object in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> possession, mayhap then our safe passage could be assured.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000590_URIANGER
62.description: White auracite would, I believe, serve as a suitable vessel for this purpose. 'Twas conceived to imprison the massy soul of an Ascian, and should house one of ours with relative ease.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000600_URIANGER
63.description: We would need only to ensure our souls' safe preservation inside the stone, and identify a means by which they might be transferred back unto our vacant bodies.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000610_MYSTERYVOICE
64.description: Soul preservation and transference... Hm. I believe I know of someone who may be able to assist us.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000620_MYSTERYVOICE
65.description: On the far shore of the Source, there stands a great palace built by the elves.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000630_MYSTERYVOICE
66.description: It was forsaken in the wake of the Flood, but a certain Nu Mou chose to make their home there soon after.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000640_MYSTERYVOICE
67.description: Though they have long lived as a recluse, they once occupied a place of honor in Voeburt's royal court, and it is said that none in all of Norvrandt is more knowledgeable than they on matters of the soul.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000650_ALISAIE
68.description: Well, I've no objection to seeking a helping hand, but if they've gone to such lengths to hide themselves away from the world, what makes you think they'd be willing to lend us one?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000660_MYSTERYVOICE
69.description: Heh. A worthy question. Years ago, I myself tried─and failed─to solicit their cooperation in the battle against the sin eaters.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000670_MYSTERYVOICE
70.description: No sooner had I begun to make my plea than they unleashed a swarm of their familiars upon me.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000680_MYSTERYVOICE
71.description: Unlike me, however, you have curried favor with the fae folk. By that merit alone, I am hopeful that they would grant you an audience.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000690_MYSTERYVOICE
72.description: They may still be inclined to turn you away, of course, but if their knowledge might feasibly facilitate your return home, we have to try.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000700_BEQLUGG
73.description: That was my fiercest familiar. Impressive...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000710_MYSTERYVOICE
74.description: Beq Lugg. 'Tis good to see you again after all these years.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000720_MYSTERYVOICE
75.description: And judging by your vigorous greeting, I daresay the feeling is mutual. To be sure, a simple <hex:021A020203>shake<hex:021A020103> of the hand would have sufficed by way of welcome, but I shan't complain.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000730_MYSTERYVOICE
76.description: But you must be wondering as to the purpose of our visit. We come to <hex:021A020203>beg<hex:021A020103> your assistance in a most urgent matter.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000750_MYSTERYVOICE
78.description: Our comrades' very souls are in danger. If we are to save them, we will need the benefit of your unsurpassed knowledge on the matter. Please, will you not <hex:021A020203>sit<hex:021A020103> and hear our plea?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000760_BEQLUGG
79.description: Oh... How dare you. How dare you speak thus in my presence.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000770_BEQLUGG
80.description: It was to escape such words of temptation that I hid myself from the world of men...

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000780_BEQLUGG
81.description: You are sinners one and all, and I swore never again to have any part in your affairs.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000790_ALPHINAUD
82.description: I can only imagine what terrible events forced you into a life of seclusion...

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000800_ALPHINAUD
83.description: But I know that the Nu Mou are a good and noble folk. It is not in your nature to turn a blind eye to the plight of those around you. And in treating with us, I am certain whatever mistrust you feel for man will begin to...<hex:021A020203>heel<hex:021A020103>.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000820_BEQLUGG
85.description: If you will not be satisfied... I suppose I could listen... After all, there's no harm in just─

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000830_BEQLUGG
86.description: No! No, no, no! I mustn't. Not again...

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000840_BEQLUGG
87.description: That damned court mage seemed to have the best of intentions too, and countless innocents died for my naivety!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000850_BEQLUGG
88.description: You know not what you ask of me. What horrors my knowledge has wrought...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
90.description: Refuse all you want! We won't lie down and accept defeat!

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
92.description: You mean the magical plague of Voeburt?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000870_BEQLUGG
94.description: Of all the visitors I could possibly have... They're even more stubborn than I am...!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000880_BEQLUGG
95.description: You wish only to save your friends? Nothing more?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000910_BEQLUGG
98.description: Then you know how dangerous soulcraft can be! Instead of saving your friends, you risk damning them. Are you sure you're willing to take that chance?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000940_BEQLUGG
101.description: I will hear your petition, but that is all! And I expect fitting payment for my troubles...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000950_MYSTERYVOICE
102.description: Commensurate with your contribution to our cause. No more and no less, I promise you.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000960_MYSTERYVOICE
103.description: With that settled─might I impose upon you to join us at the Crystarium? I'm afraid the nature of my friends' predicament calls for absolute secrecy.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000970_BEQLUGG
104.description: I'm sorry... You mean to tell me not only that the return of night was your doing...

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000980_BEQLUGG
105.description: ...But that you hail from another world as well!?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_000990_MYSTERYVOICE
106.description: Everything we told you─of the Source, the shards, the seven Umbral Calamities─all of it is true.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001000_MYSTERYVOICE
107.description: I realize how fantastical it sounds, and I would not blame you for doubting our testimony...

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001010_MYSTERYVOICE
108.description: But given your expertise, you must surely have noted the peculiar nature of their souls.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001020_BEQLUGG
109.description: Any other time, and I would have dismissed your stories as balderdash and flummery. But upon closer inspection, 'tis plain their souls are far denser than is normal. And that they do not possess true bodies.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001030_BEQLUGG
110.description: Save you. Your body is your own.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001040_BEQLUGG
111.description: And your soul is the densest of them all.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001060_MYSTERYVOICE
113.description: As I said before, were it not for their heroism, the skies over Norvrandt would still be awash with Light, the realm yet at the mercy of Vauthry and the sin eaters.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001070_MYSTERYVOICE
114.description: After all they have done for our home, seeing them safely back to their own seems the very least we can do.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001090_BEQLUGG
116.description: Your tale is intriguing. Yes, very intriguing indeed. Simply to hear it is fitting payment in itself.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001100_BEQLUGG
117.description: As for your friends...I can but agree. Their valorous deeds on behalf of Norvrandt are deserving of recognition. Of their own fitting payment.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001120_BEQLUGG
119.description: I will. I would see my knowledge put to good use for a change.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001130_BEQLUGG
120.description: I do have one condition, however. I am not the spry young Nu Mou I once was. As such, I will require assistance in my fieldwork and testing.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001140_ALPHINAUD
121.description: It would be our pleasure. We will be laboring for our own benefit, after all.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001160_BEQLUGG
123.description: I trust you've prepared the clay?

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001170_BEQLUGG
124.description: Very good. Now, I would have you sculpt for me...a porxie.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001175_BEQLUGG
125.description: Plump, with floppy ears, and a short, curly tail.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001180_ALISAIE
126.description: A porxie. I...think I know what you mean...

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001200_ALPHINAUD
128.description: Well... It is certainly creative. There's no denying that.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001220_ALISAIE
130.description: Yes, yes, I'm no artist. Very funny!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001230_BEQLUGG
131.description: Pay him no mind, child. Though it may look like a grotesque parody of reality, it is what the invoker believes that matters.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001250_BEQLUGG
133.description: But I speak the truth. If successful, this incantation will turn imagination into reality.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001260_BEQLUGG
134.description: Which is why the only thing of import is what you believe this figure embodies. You must focus. Hold the porxie's image steady in your mind's eye.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001270_BEQLUGG
135.description: Now then, as I taught you. Relax, and allow your energies to flow.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001280_ALISAIE
136.description: With flesh of clay I bid thee rise,<hex:02100103>On wings of dreams to touch the skies.<hex:02100103>What once was idle fantasy,<hex:02100103>I call forth to reality!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001290_BEQLUGG
138.description: Hmmm. Not bad for a first attempt.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001300_BEQLUGG
139.description: Now, let us see what can be done for young Halric.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001310_BEQLUGG
140.description: Through the operation of the magicks you invoked to animate this familiar, it is now replete with the energies required to stir the boy's soul.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001320_BEQLUGG
141.description: You need but give it a name, and it will do as your heart desires.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001390_ALPHINAUD
148.description: Lady Chai, whatever is the matter?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001400_DULIACHAI
149.description: I...I knew not where else to turn. Oh, this is all too much for my poor heart to bear alone.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001420_DULIACHAI
151.description: But that is the very reason I summoned you! He's gone!

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001440_DULIACHAI
153.description: It all began after the events at Mt. Gulg...

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001450_DULIACHAI
154.description: With Lord Vauthry out of the way, we all agreed that a new leader must be chosen...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001470_DULIACHAI
156.description: Yes. Well...sort of. Not a single person volunteered to stand, you see.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001480_DULIACHAI
157.description: After a lifetime of leisure, we free citizens have grown somewhat...indolent. Readapting to the harsh realities of life is trying enough, but to take charge of a broken city as well? No one wanted such responsibility.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001490_DULIACHAI
158.description: Nevertheless, Eulmore could not well do without a leader, and so we decided that anyone and everyone should be considered a candidate. And after we cast our ballots and tallied the votes, the mayorship fell upon my dear husband.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001500_ALPHINAUD
159.description: Well, given the manner in which he orchestrated the construction of the giant Talos, none could deny his leadership qualities.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001510_DULIACHAI
160.description: But even before then, he had proven himself at Daedalus Stoneworks, don't forget. He is more than qualified for the role. The perfect choice.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001520_DULIACHAI
161.description: Indeed, I told him as much when his victory was first announced.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001530_DULIACHAI
162.description: But perhaps I was too forceful in my attempt to encourage him. For shortly after that, he vanished without a word...

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001540_ALPHINAUD
164.description: You believe he was so daunted by the burden of leadership that he felt compelled to flee...?

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001550_ALPHINAUD
165.description: Please, Lady Chai, dry your eyes.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001560_ALPHINAUD
166.description: Your husband does not strike me as the sort of man who would abandon his duty, much less his beloved wife. There has to be some other reason for his absence.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001580_DULIACHAI
168.description: What about you? What do you think has become of my husband?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
170.description: I don't know. But whatever it is, he won't have fled.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
171.description: Sorry, but I think he's fled.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001600_ALPHINAUD
172.description: And there you have it, Lady Chai. You needn't worry. Master Chai loves you more than all the world, and he will return.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001590_ALPHINAUD
173.description: Nay, my friend. The one thing he has not done is flee─of that I am convinced. Through the most testing of times, he has ever remained at Lady Chai's side, placing her happiness before his own. He would not abandon her now.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001610_ALPHINAUD
174.description: Wherever he may have gone, rest assured we will find him.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001620_DULIACHAI
175.description: Thank you, my dear boy. You have set my mind at ease. I will trust in my husband, and await his return.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001640_WRENDEN
177.description: And I see you've invited your friends. Need them to fight your battles for you, do you?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001650_CHAINUZZ
178.description: I didn't invite them, as it happens...though they are indeed my friends. Not only mine, but every true Eulmoran's.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001660_CHAINUZZ
179.description: They are the ones who awakened us to the truth─to Lord Vauthry's villainy. The famous Warriors of Darkness.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001680_CHAINUZZ
181.description: Yes. They are. It would be no exaggeration to call them our saviors. We owe much and more to their kindness. But we cannot depend on that kindness forever.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001690_CHAINUZZ
182.description: To do so would be little different from entrusting our affairs to Lord Vauthry. Nay, we must learn to stand on our own two feet, and I would have them present to witness my attempt.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001710_WRENDEN
184.description: Your sentiments are admirable. Yet admirable sentiments do not a nation make.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001720_WRENDEN
185.description: In my capacity as advisor, I once strove to build a better Eulmore. Gave honest counsel to my superiors. Drafted laws for the benefit of one and all...

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001730_WRENDEN
186.description: But in time, my values fell out of favor. There was no need for them in this paradise Vauthry was creating. And so I left my homeland behind.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001740_WRENDEN
187.description: But you, Chai-Nuzz─you were content to wallow in indolence under Vauthry's auspices. And so I cannot help but ask myself what manner of nation you intend to build.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001750_CHAINUZZ
188.description: I...I can offer no simple answer to that question.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001760_CHAINUZZ
189.description: But this much I will say...

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001770_CHAINUZZ
190.description: It is my hope that Eulmore can become a nation which her citizens might freely choose to build together.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001780_CHAINUZZ
191.description: A great many people─myself included─flocked to Eulmore seeking sanctuary. The alternative being to live in fear and die in pain, it seemed an easy choice.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001790_CHAINUZZ
192.description: And sanctuary we found. As much food and drink as we could ever want, secured at the cost of the surrounding villages. Little wonder the people gathered at our doorstep, begging to work among the bonded.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001800_CHAINUZZ
193.description: The free were blind to it all, of course. Content to─as you say─wallow in indolence. In ignorance...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001810_CHAINUZZ
194.description: Were I mayor, I would first take stock of the city's resources, and see that they were assigned equitably. Our days of reckless consumption are behind us.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001820_CHAINUZZ
195.description: The distinction between free and bonded died with Vauthry. The needs of rich and poor alike must be considered if our nation is to survive.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001830_CHAINUZZ
196.description: To which end, I would take steps to secure channels for supplies, rekindle relations with nearby settlements, reestablish industry, reach out to neighboring nations...and the list goes on and on.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001840_CHAINUZZ
197.description: But I am no ruler, nor even a politician─I am an entrepreneur.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001850_CHAINUZZ
198.description: My expertise lie in planning and profit. I haven't the knowledge or experience to run a nation.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001860_CHAINUZZ
199.description: Please, Wrenden. Will you not help me? Together, we could solve the city's problems. Build a Eulmore for the people.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001880_WRENDEN
201.description: I rather like the sound of that.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001890_WRENDEN
202.description: But before I offer you my counsel, I would be certain of your ability to perform the duties of office.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001910_WRENDEN
204.description: You ask me to help you solve Eulmore's problems, but first, I would see you solve one on your own. Accomplish that, and you will prove both to me and the people that you are a man worth following.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001920_CHAINUZZ
206.description: Right. Right, then. Form a line and make for Eulmore!

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_001990_CHAINUZZ
213.description: Well of course I'm back. You didn't s─

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002030_DULIACHAI
217.description: I'm sorry, my darling... It's just, the sight of you filled me with such joy, I couldn't help myself...

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002040_CHAINUZZ
218.description: It's all right, dear. I should just have come out and said what it was I was intending, instead of entrusting the task to a hastily scribbled letter.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002050_DULIACHAI
219.description: Does that mean you'll do it?

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002060_CHAINUZZ
220.description: Well, I'm here, aren't I? I mean, not that my absence signified any unwillingness, you understand.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002070_CHAINUZZ
221.description: Naught could be further from the truth! I only left to enlist the aid of the former mayor's senior advisor.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002080_CHAINUZZ
222.description: And now that I have it, I believe I am ready to take office.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002120_CHAINUZZ
228.description: Thank you all for gathering here today.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002130_CHAINUZZ
229.description: Before going any further─could I...could I ask the free citizens of Eulmore to look around?

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002140_CHAINUZZ
230.description: 'Tis a sight none of us would ever have seen under Lord Vauthry's rule.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002150_CHAINUZZ
231.description: Not only do we stand in the familiar presence of those we once called the bonded...

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002160_CHAINUZZ
232.description: ...But today we welcome the peoples of the Derelicts and Gatetown too.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002170_CHAINUZZ
233.description: Today we welcome the Warriors of Darkness, come to bear witness to Eulmore's new beginning.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002180_CHAINUZZ
234.description: As you know, an election was recently held, at the end of which I had the honor of being chosen to succeed Lord Vauthry.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002190_CHAINUZZ
235.description: You place great faith in me, and I promise to do my utmost to live up to your expectations. And I will seek always to carry out the duties of this office with integrity and fairness.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002200_CHAINUZZ
236.description: Always, I say, but not forever. Let it be known that I do not intend to hold this post indefinitely. I consider myself but an acting mayor who will serve only for the interim, while Eulmore is reshaped according to a new set of values.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002210_CHAINUZZ
237.description: No longer can we think of ourselves as divided. As the free and the bonded. Citizens and non-citizens.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002220_CHAINUZZ
238.description: The systems put in place by Lord Vauthry must be undone. But even as we tear down the old, we must give thought to the new. To what manner of nation Eulmore should become.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002230_CHAINUZZ
239.description: Whatever the answer may be, it cannot be decided by one man alone. And so I propose that an open forum be held, that we might all discuss how best to strive towards a better future.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002240_CHAINUZZ
240.description: However, there can be no talk of the morrow unless we first address the issues of today.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002250_CHAINUZZ
241.description: Securing new sources of food, rebuilding relations with our neighbors, re-establishing industry─there is much and more that needs to be done.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002260_CHAINUZZ
242.description: Too much for a mere man of business. And so I pledge instead to do everything in my power to ensure our city's security and stability while we all work together to see these problems solved.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002270_CHAINUZZ
243.description: The road before us will not be easy, and I know full well how daunting the prospect of honest labor may seem to some of you...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002280_CHAINUZZ
244.description: But we must accept the reality of our circumstances. We must move forward.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002290_CHAINUZZ
245.description: This much we owe to ourselves, and to the brave heroes who risked their lives to bring back the night.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002300_CHAINUZZ
246.description: Once we have shored up our city's foundations, and regained some semblance of normality, let us reconvene to speak of the future.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002310_CHAINUZZ
247.description: Until then, I humbly ask that you lend me, and each other, your strength. For Eulmore!

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002330_KRILE
249.description: I have carried out the treatment as per Master Matoya's instructions. It should slow the destabilization of their corporeal aether quite significantly.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002340_KRILE
250.description: But tell me, how fare our friends in the First?

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002350_TATARU
251.description: So this Beq Lugg's the First's leading authority on soulcraft, are they? Sounds promising!

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002360_KRILE
252.description: And Urianger's proffered solution of white auracite is rather ingenious now that I think of it.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002370_KRILE
253.description: Well, while they press on with their preparations, you may rest assured we will continue to do our part here.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002390_ESTINIEN
255.description: And none the worse for wear, I see.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002400_TATARU
256.description: Estinien! Oh, thank the gods. We've been worried sick! Did you lose your linkpearl or something!?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002410_ESTINIEN
257.description: The situation in Garlemald has become more complicated. I was making my escape from the capital when I ran into one of yours─Riol. He thought it best we come straight here.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002435_ESTINIEN
260.description: After entering the Empire via Radz-at-Han, I went about my mission of investigating Black Rose.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002440_ESTINIEN
261.description: It was then, inside a provincial factory, that I encountered the one who styles himself Shadowhunter. Gaius Baelsar.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002450_ESTINIEN
262.description: Our goals being apparently aligned, we joined forces and ventured on into the heart of the capital─to the very imperial palace itself.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002460_ESTINIEN
263.description: There, we found a man whom all assumed dead.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002470_ESTINIEN
264.description: But his soul lives on. And he has wrested back his flesh.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002480_ESTINIEN
266.description: Nor did the surprises end there. For no sooner had we arrived than he murdered his sire in cold blood. The Emperor is dead. This sent Gaius into a rage, and he charged in, blade drawn...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002680_ESTINIEN
269.description: Peer into my past, did you?

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002690_KRILE
270.description: Well, I didn't quite relive the experience as you did, but I bore witness to it all.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002700_ESTINIEN
271.description: I'm still not sure what I think of this gift of yours. But no matter.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002710_ESTINIEN
272.description: Our confrontation was cut short when the imperial guard arrived. It was then that Zenos took his leave. Citing boredom.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002720_KRILE
273.description: To think their research into the Echo could bear such fruit...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002730_KRILE
274.description: Escaping death, jumping from one body to the next, and returning to his own after all this time... He is an Ascian in all but name.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002740_ESTINIEN
275.description: It beggars belief, aye. But no more than a hero traversing the rift between worlds.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002750_ESTINIEN
276.description: My concerns are far more prosaic. With the Emperor dead and the crown prince missing, the Empire is in disarray.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002760_ESTINIEN
277.description: Until order is restored─assuming it even possible─we needn't fear an imperial reprisal. And for reasons of his own, Zenos took it upon himself to rid the world of Black Rose.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002770_ESTINIEN
278.description: Riol has already gone to apprise the Alliance leaders of these developments. We may leave the matter in their hands for now.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002780_KRILE
279.description: Then perhaps we have seen the last of the fighting at Ghimlyt. Though if it comes to civil war, I cannot help but fear for the provinces...

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002790_KRILE
280.description: Ah, I'd nearly forgotten to ask─what became of Gaius? Did he not escape with you?

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002800_ESTINIEN
281.description: That he did, but we parted ways shortly after leaving Garlemald. He claimed another threat had arisen which demanded his attention.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002810_ESTINIEN
282.description: He didn't elaborate, but the absence of some device or other in the capital gave him reason to believe they're planning something.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002820_ESTINIEN
283.description: Lest you worry, I believe he has well and truly shed the Black Wolf's pelt. Conquest is no longer his objective. We may safely leave him to his own devices.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002830_TATARU
284.description: Well, it's nice to have one less foe to worry about...even if we do have a mysterious new threat to look out for instead.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002840_TATARU
285.description: Speaking of which, I'll see that Riol and our shinobi are made aware. Though we still know next to nothing, it can't hurt to be vigilant.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002850_ESTINIEN
286.description: Well then, with Black Rose nipped in the bud, I believe I've fulfilled my part of the bargain.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002860_TATARU
287.description: That's...true, buuut...with the Archons still slumbering away, we were hoping you might agree to stay with us for a little bit longer...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002870_ESTINIEN
288.description: Sorry, but I'm not inclined to extend my contract. Gaius isn't the only one with business to attend to.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002880_KRILE
289.description: Thank you for your help then, Estinien. I see why Alphinaud admires you so.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002900_ESTINIEN
291.description: Farewell, my friend. See that you don't make a habit of dozing off in battle.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05100_002910_KRILE
292.description: Hmm. I suppose we should all be getting on, then. As ever, we will see to the Archons' needs. In the meantime, why not get some rest? You've more than earned it. Go on.
